name: musubi-codex
description: First-class Codex adapter for durable Musubi capture and recall. Shadow-only by default; verified delivery is an explicit deployment gate. Built on the open-source musubi-harness library so the Codex and Claude seats can never silently diverge.

interface.shortDescription: Durable, policy-gated Musubi continuity for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Musubi Codex captures each completed primary turn into an identity-scoped outbox, exposes deliberate recall through a five-tool MCP facade, and routes explicit remember through durable receipt lookup and exact readback. Shadow-only by default — remote delivery is an explicit deployment gate that requires a deployed durable-receipt API and a live one-object canary.
defaultPrompt: Show my Musubi continuity and local shadow-capture status for this Codex seat.
Search my recent Musubi captures for the last commit on slice-plane-episodic.
Remember that the musubi-harness library is the source of identity, namespace, and delivery policy.
